# Stage 2 results (generated by run_stage2.py)

True market: Stage 1 base case. Training: 5 runs (seeds 101–105), using the first D of 1,000 simulated hours. Test: 20,000 hours from the reserved seed 303. Costs are mean implementation shortfall in bps of arrival notional on the test hours, averaged over runs. Intervals are paired 95% intervals over test hours for the run-averaged costs; they do not include run-to-run variation, which is shown separately. Learned model: 1,666 parameters. Runtime 1368 s.

## Execution cost on test hours (bps, lower is better)

| Training hours | TWAP | Best simple rule | Fitted classical model + planner | Learned model + planner | True model + planner (ceiling) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 50 | +1.38 | +1.38 (TWAP in 5/5 runs) | -1.56 | -0.96 | -1.53 |
| 200 | +1.38 | +1.38 (TWAP in 5/5 runs) | -1.54 | -1.47 | -1.53 |
| 1,000 | +1.38 | +1.38 (TWAP in 5/5 runs) | -1.53 | -1.47 | -1.53 |

## Hypothesis comparisons (bps, 95% CI)

Saving = best simple rule cost − strategy cost (positive: the strategy is cheaper). Cost of model error = strategy cost − true model + planner cost (positive: worse than the ceiling). Learned − fitted: positive means the learned model is costlier.

| Training hours | H1: learned saving vs best rule | Range over runs | Fitted saving vs best rule | H3: learned cost of model error | Fitted cost of model error | H4: learned − fitted |

| 200 | +2.86 [+2.68, +3.03] | +2.76 to +2.97 | +2.92 [+2.74, +3.10] | +0.06 [+0.05, +0.07] | -0.01 [-0.01, -0.00] | +0.06 [+0.05, +0.07] |
